content: Cloud->self-hosted migration: use supabase db dump (CLI strips internal schemas/reserved roles) not raw pg_dump; test on staging for PG version mismatch. Self-hosted uses Supavisor pooler: port 5432 session mode (like direct conn, supports prepared statements), 6543 transaction mode (pooled). What changes moving off cloud: connection string host, service/anon keys, and the JWKS/auth URL (self-hosted auth exposes its own /auth/v1/jwks). If DB access is isolated behind Express via a single db client module + env-configured URL/keys, migration = swap env vars.
